svg.text: 1 M3 x 6 socket head cap screw; head on the rear panel, Ø3.4 clearance
2 Insert M3 x 3, printed Ø4.0 hole, 0.5 x 45° relief chamfer
3 Gussets at 45° to both walls: the post prints with no support
5 Insert M3 x 3 in the 3 mm spacer frame
6 M3 x 5 pan head through the driver flange
Joint details: rear post and driver mount
